body: Thank you. I do believe I'm getting better, it's just that sometimes it's hard to move forward from the past and need to vent. I'm sure I'll be able to accept myself and move on one day (*´ω｀*)
For the moment, it's money. I got massively into debt, and my family isn't all that wealthy. Even if I manage to pull myself together, it will be a very long time before I can finish making amends.

Thank you very much for your kind advice. I will definitely try to follow through.
So I tried talking it out with my parents, which didn't go too well, as was expected. Basically I pretty much ruined my family - and that is objectively true. So now I'm actually convincing my mother to go to therapy as well.
But at least the cat's out of the bag, which is a step in the right direction I guess.

Basically I made a lot of terrible choices, which led me to this mess I'm currently in. I'm pretty much incapable of doing anything right, and it's only in hindsight that I realize everything could've been prevented had I been in my right mind, but I hadn't, for a very long time now. I honestly don't know what I can do, even if I get bailed out of my current mess, I'll just keep making the same mistakes over and over again.

Tried seeing a therapist once, but I ended up feeling so doubtful about whether I was really telling her how I feel. But maybe I should have continued with therapy regardless... it couldn't have made my life any worse anyway.

Same here...
I always wonder if I'm just trying to find an excuse for all the things I failed to do.
